author: UneCookie
body:
Hello Avicus,

It has been a long time. After being banned for hving too many infractmions by a senior mod named Fouled at the time, I was told to wait 6 months before I could appeal and get unbanned due to the ban apparently being a mixture of a permanent and temporary ban. Therefore, I have waited this time and will hopefully be allowed back onto this community. As Fouled said in his reply to my previous appeal, I feel that I have learnt my lesson and have matured greatly since my ban, I regret my bad actions and would really love it if I was given another chance. As an example, posting that innapropriate link, at the time I thought I was a comedic genious for what I thought was a joke now, but I now realise this was silly and overall immature. In addition to this, all of the infractions for things such as profanity were me trying to build my ego and look cool however I frankly have no issue with peoples' opinions on my behaviour, i.e. I will  not be bad in order to show off because I now see the light at the end of the tunnel; misbehaviour for that sole reasion is ridiculous! Despite my lack of evidence for my next point I will say it regardless; I feel that as a whole in real life I too have matured and grown up; this has gained me popularity and it has shown me the true meaning of friends, not people that I need to look good in front of; people that appreciate me for who I am.

My evidence on my first point is as shown below (in a reply to this post) sorry about the bad screenshot I cant edit at all.


It would be an honour to be given a second chance and I hope all  of you will take me back. The last thing I can say is, from the bottom of my heart, I am sorry for everything bad I have done and will make sure never to repeat to the 100% best of my abilities.

With love,
Unequalz
